title: Sherman's mother abducted and fetus 'genetically managed'

tellings.quote: And so in 1963 when she was uh when she was um uh had me you know in term um they abducted her again and they uh did the genetic management.

plain: In 1963, while she was pregnant with him, Dan Sherman's mother was abducted again by aliens who carried out "genetic management" on the unborn baby, according to Sherman. Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency hired him to communicate with aliens, says he was told this by a man he calls Captain White. If true, it would explain why he says he was chosen for that work.
